description: Fixtures and results for a competition — Premier League, Championship, Primera División/La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Brasileirão, Copa Libertadores, UEFA Champions League, European Championship, or the World Cup (see `competition` codes below). Filter by status (SCHEDULED, LIVE, IN_PLAY, PAUSED, FINISHED, POSTPONED, SUSPENDED, CANCELLED), date range, matchday, stage, or season year. "Next round" / "upcoming fixtures" questions: pass no `status` or `status: "SCHEDULED"`, not a matchday number, unless the caller already knows which matchday number it is.

competition.description: Competition code (e.g., "PL" = Premier League, "PD" = La Liga, "CL" = Champions League)

status.description: Match status filter (SCHEDULED | LIVE | IN_PLAY | PAUSED | FINISHED | POSTPONED | SUSPENDED | CANCELLED)

name: get_competition_matches
